title: Authentication Login UI Journey
description: Draft UI semantic model instance for the login journey, separate from visual styling and source JSX structure.
aiGuidance: Regenerate UI from semantics; do not invent validation, permission, accessibility, or journey behaviour from visual design.
validations: required login input is represented before submission
provider selection is represented before redirect or callback handling
custom-domain callback origin is represented as source-backed lineage, not live-provider proof
deferred real-IdP claim mapping is visible as a readiness limitation
errors: no-session state redirects or blocks authenticated surfaces
stale proof or readiness failure cannot be shown as ready
accessibility: error state is announced without relying on visual styling only
